title: 直壁彩色阶梯
description: 剪纸将短阶梯路线与完整人物剪影构成明快场景。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original cut-paper illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult following a short staircase of large holds on a low vertical bouldering panel. Broad red-orange handholds alternate with blue positive footholds, allowing the climber to take a modest upward step while keeping three comfortable contacts. Show a whole-body wide view with layered cream wall planes, visible paper fibers, and thick continuous crash mats stretching across the foreground. The route ends at a low reachable hold rather than a high top-out. Keep limbs proportionate and shoe contact clear. Use gentle stacked shadows and opaque clothing shapes. Exclude lettering, logos, leaps, dramatic exposure, and portrait-only composition.
